title: 第5章 灵药殿前第6章 小人狗奴
content_zh:
第5章灵药殿前
短短一日时间，打通两条灵脉，这要是说出去，只怕是人人都会以为楚风眠是个怪物。
想要单单依靠自己的力量，打通一条灵脉，其中便是千难万难，更何况是一天之内，打通两条。
“这断骨重生决，果然不愧是曾经的第一法决。”
楚风眠心中暗叹一声，不过也只有像是楚风眠这样心志坚定之人，才可以修炼这断骨重生决来开辟灵脉。
对于寻常灵师来说，无数次的破碎重塑灵脉，足以是让他们疼晕过去，这一单昏厥，便是就只有死路一条。
正因如此，能够修炼这断骨重生决的人，寥寥无几。
前生楚风眠不知道受过多少痛苦，也无法修炼，这一次终于有着修炼机会，楚风眠又怎么可能放弃。
在打通第二条灵脉的同时，楚风眠也发现，他现在身体的力量，已经是比起之前要强上了数倍不止。
论起力量来说，已经是刚刚的十倍有余。
“淬骨境三重。”
楚风眠感觉了一下，果然他的境界，同样因为灵脉的打通，踏入到了淬骨境三重的境界。
三十五枚淬骨丹，理论上来说足以是让淬骨境一重的武者，踏入到淬骨境二重。
不过这只是对寻常武者来说的，寻常武者炼化丹药，能够吞噬其中五成灵力已经是极为不易，而楚风眠却是足以十成尽收，几乎毫无损耗，正因如此，他才足以依赖者三十五没淬骨丹，一举踏入到淬骨境三重。
楚风眠起身，暗自催动起魅影身法来，顿时楚风眠的身形，便是快的惊人，在这房间之中动这。
在这房间之中，楚风眠的身影足足有着三道，其中两道，便正是因为速度而产生的虚影。
如今踏入到淬骨境三重，楚风眠也终于是可以催动魅影身法了，虽然只能是出现两道虚影，而并没有达到传说之中虚影千万的地步，但是起码对付淬骨境五重之下的武者，楚风眠有着自信。
“走，出去练练。”
楚风眠推开房门，看着天空夜色，他的身躯在院落之中，不断的动这，重复这凝聚虚影，在熟悉这魅影身法。
等到楚风眠休息的时候，天色，已经变亮。

一夜不睡，楚风眠也并无困意，相反他却极为精神，对武者来说，修炼，比起睡觉还要精神的多，像是许多武道强者，几乎足以保持数十年数百年不睡，随时随刻都在修炼武道。
凭借这一晚时间，楚风眠终于也是将魅影身法熟悉，修炼到了小成地步。
楚风眠本就是天资极高之人，前世的他只是无法催动灵力，自然无法修炼，而这一次一夜之中，楚风眠便是领悟到了魅影身法小成的地步。
这样一来，就算是对阵淬骨境七重的武者，虽然不足以是击败，但是也足以立于不败之地。
“今天，便是发放俸禄的日子吧。”
楚风眠低头思考了一下，今日便是月中，正是林府每月发放俸禄的日子。
平常，楚风眠的俸禄都是由林府外府的弟子带领的，等到楚风眠手里的时候，已经是不知道被克扣了多少遍了。
那个时候的楚风眠，都是有怒却不敢言，毕竟没有实力，一切都是空谈。
而这一次却是不同了，已经是踏入到了淬骨境三重的楚风眠，在这林府外府之中，已经是有着一席之地了。

Chapter 5 In front of the Elixir Palace
In just one day, two spiritual veins were opened. If this were told, everyone would think Chu Fengmian was a monster.
If you want to rely solely on your own strength to open a spiritual vein, it is extremely difficult, let alone opening two in one day.
"This Bone-Breaking Rebirth Technique is truly worthy of being the number one magic technique in the past."
Chu Fengmian sighed secretly in his heart, but only a determined person like Chu Fengmian can practice this bone-breaking rebirth technique to open up spiritual veins.
For ordinary spiritual masters, countless broken and reshaped spiritual veins are enough to make them faint from the pain. This single fainting is the only way to death.
Because of this, there are only a few people who can practice this art of bone rebirth.
Chu Fengmian suffered countless pains in his previous life and was unable to practice. This time he finally had a chance to practice. How could Chu Fengmian give up?
While opening up the second spiritual vein, Chu Fengmian also discovered that the strength of his body was now several times stronger than before.
In terms of strength, it is already more than ten times what it was just now.
"Third level of Bone Tempering Realm."
Chu Fengmian felt it, and sure enough, his realm had also reached the third level of Bone Tempering Realm due to the opening of his spiritual veins.
Thirty-five Bone Tempering Pills are theoretically enough to allow a warrior at the first level of the Bone Tempering Realm to step into the second level of the Bone Tempering Realm.
But this is only for ordinary warriors. It is extremely difficult for ordinary warriors to refine elixirs and absorb 50% of the spiritual power. However, Chu Fengmian is able to absorb 100% of them with almost no loss. Because of this, he is able to rely on thirty-five bone-tempering pills and step into the third level of bone-tempering realm in one fell swoop.
Chu Fengmian stood up and secretly activated the Phantom Body Technique. Suddenly, Chu Fengmian's figure moved at an alarming speed in the room.
In this room, there are three figures of Chu Fengmian, two of which are phantoms caused by speed.
Now that he has entered the third level of the Bone Tempering Realm, Chu Fengmian can finally activate the phantom movement technique. Although only two phantoms can appear, and it has not reached the legendary level of tens of thousands of phantoms, at least Chu Fengmian is confident in dealing with warriors below the fifth level of the Bone Tempering Realm.
"Let's go out and practice."
Chu Fengmian opened the door and looked at the sky and night. His body was moving in the courtyard, repeating the condensed shadow, getting familiar with the phantom movement.
By the time Chu Fengmian rested, the sky had become brighter.
After not sleeping all night, Chu Fengmian did not feel sleepy. On the contrary, he was extremely energetic. For a warrior, practicing is much more energetic than sleeping. For example, many martial arts masters can stay awake for decades or hundreds of years, practicing martial arts at all times.
With this night, Chu Fengmian finally became familiar with the Phantom Body Technique and practiced it to a small degree.
Chu Fengmian is a very talented person. In his previous life, he just couldn't activate his spiritual power, so naturally he couldn't practice. But this time, Chu Fengmian realized the phantom body technique in one night.
In this way, even if it is against a warrior at the seventh level of the Bone Tempering Realm, although it is not enough to defeat him, it is still enough to remain invincible.
"Today is the day when salaries are distributed."
Chu Fengmian lowered his head and thought for a moment. Today is the middle of the month, which is the day when Lin Mansion pays out monthly salary.
Normally, Chu Fengmian's salary would be led by disciples from outside the Lin family. By the time Chu Fengmian got it, he had been deducted countless times.
At that time, Chu Fengmian was angry but dared not speak out. After all, he had no strength and everything was just talk.
But this time it was different. Chu Fengmian, who had already entered the third level of the Bone Tempering Realm, already had a place in the outer palace of the Lin Mansion.
